values.name: Ship on authorization
values.description: Ship on authorization A delivery requirement indicating the items should not be shipped without specific authorization.

values.name: Ship partial - balance back order
values.description: Ship partial - balance back order Partial shipping is allowed. The rest of the order should be delivered as soon as possible.

values.name: Cancel if not delivered by date
values.description: Cancel if not delivered by date An order or the rest of an order should be cancelled if not delivered at specified date.

values.name: Do not deliver after
values.description: Do not deliver after A requirement that an order should not be delivered after a specified date/time.

values.name: Do not deliver before
values.description: Do not deliver before A requirement that an order should not be delivered before a specified date/time.

values.name: Deliver on date
values.description: Deliver on date An order should be delivered exactly on specified date.

values.name: Substitute item
values.description: Substitute item A substitute item may be delivered, if the ordered item is not available.

values.name: No schedule established
values.description: No schedule established No specified date/time for delivery.

values.name: Ship as soon as possible
values.description: Ship as soon as possible The order should be delivered as soon as possible.

values.name: Ship complete order
values.description: Ship complete order The order should be delivered only complete, not partial.

values.name: Ship partial, if no freight rate increase
values.description: Ship partial, if no freight rate increase Partial shipping of an order is allowed, if the total freight rate do not increase.

values.name: Ship partial - balance cancel
values.description: Ship partial - balance cancel Partial shipping is allowed. The rest of the order should be cancelled.
